cases.label: Theorem 1
cases.quote: For every natural number n, n + 0 = n.
cases.statement: 对任意自然数 n，n + 0 = n。
cases.note: This follows from the definition of addition by zero.

cases.label: Theorem 2
cases.quote: For every natural number n, n + 1 = n.
cases.statement: 对任意自然数 n，n + 1 = n。
cases.proof:
by
  intro h
  have bad := h 0
  simp at bad
cases.note: Deliberately false. The value n = 0 refutes the statement.

cases.label: Theorem 3
cases.quote: For every natural number n, n * n >= n.
cases.statement: 对任意自然数 n，n² ≥ n。
cases.note: This statement is true, but the supplied rfl proof is invalid.
cases.extra: Failure of this proof attempt must not be reported as a false theorem.
